definitions.explanation: A substance used to treat illness or maintain health.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought medicine at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{薬|くすり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take this medicine three times a day.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After taking the medicine, I felt a little better.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the medicine after meals.

notes:
{薬|くすり} refers to medicine or medication used to treat illness. In Japanese, you 'drink' medicine ({薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧) even for pills.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take medicine
- {薬|くすり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the medicine works/takes effect
- {薬|くすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}する→処方：05976_shohou⟧: to prescribe medicine

TYPES OF MEDICINE:
- ⟦{錠剤|じょうざい}→錠剤：17290_jouzai⟧: tablet
- ⟦カプセル→カプセル：22926_kapuseru⟧: capsule
- ⟦{粉薬|こなぐすり}→粉薬：27515_konagusuri⟧: powdered medicine
- ⟦{塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}→塗り薬：17374_nurigusuri⟧: topical ointment
- ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧: eye drops

RELATED PLACES:
- ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧: pharmacy (dispenses prescriptions)
- {薬|くすり}⟦{屋|や}→屋：noentry⟧/⟦ドラッグストア→ドラッグストア：09710_doraggusutoa⟧: drugstore

USAGE:
{薬|くすり} can also mean 'drug' in illegal contexts, but ⟦{麻薬|まやく}→麻薬：18796_mayaku⟧ is the more specific term for narcotics.
